purpose: Teach: 異国/もとづい/予知/相反/強硬/残虐/妊婦/修道院

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、異国市場での競争力を高めろ
lines.en: Strengthen our competitiveness in foreign markets.
lines.style: Measured command. Crisp attack on the opening word. Even pace, no flourish. Authority without performance. Eyes scan the room to confirm receipt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。データにもとづいた経営判断を進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll proceed with data-driven business decisions.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Steady, assured delivery. Professional confidence without overreach. Slightly faster than the boss—eager to demonstrate understanding and execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、リスクは予知できる範囲で備えろ
lines.style: Flat statement, no softening. Slight pause before the final word, letting it land. Matter-of-fact. The tone of someone who has seen what happens when people don't prepare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、相反する意見も歓迎しております
lines.en: Yes. We actively welcome differing viewpoints within the organization.
lines.style: Careful precision. Slight emphasis on 'actively' and 'welcome'—demonstrating alignment with the directive. Calm, formal register. A touch slower to show thoughtfulness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合への強硬な対応は避けろ
lines.style: Quiet but firm. Short sentence weight. A slight edge underneath—not negotiable. The pause between clauses feels deliberate, almost warning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。残虐な広告は控えております
lines.en: Yes. We're being careful to avoid inflammatory advertising.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, then careful expansion. Slight defensive note—reassuring the boss that they've already thought of this. Professional, slightly formal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、妊婦向け商品の開発を進めろ
lines.en: Develop product lines targeting pregnant customers.
lines.style: Clear command. Straightforward phrasing. No hesitation. Direct eye contact implied in the vocal delivery. Measured pace—this is important, not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元修道院との取引も検討しております
lines.en: Yes. We're also exploring partnerships with the local convent.
lines.style: Closing note of confidence. Steady delivery with a subtle sense of completion. Respectful, professional. Slight warmth—showing initiative, closing the meeting with forward momentum.
